title: El Niño Drought Then Floods Devastate North Andhra Pradesh Farmers
detail: El Niño-driven drought followed by successive flooding has hit farmers across North Andhra Pradesh, compounding agricultural losses across the region. The back-to-back climate extremes have decimated crops, leaving farming communities facing severe economic hardship as they contend with both prolonged dry spells and destructive inundation in the same season.

media.caption: Farmers in North Andhra Pradesh face devastation from El Niño drought followed by floods
